meta.title: Serivisi za IT na software mu Rwanda
meta.description: Serivisi esheshatu z'itsinda rimwe i Kigali: design, imbuga n'apps, sisitemu na MoMo, MacyePay, mudasobwa n'ibikoresho, n'ubufasha bwa IT.

statement: Linse ishushanya, yubaka, isohora kandi icunga ikoranabuhanga ry’ibigo n’inzego mu Rwanda no mu karere.
Serivisi esheshatu ahantu hamwe: igishushanyo, imbuga na porogaramu, sisitemu no kuzihuza, porogaramu dusohora, ibikoresho n’ikwirakwizwa, na serivisi za IT.
Ikipe imwe ijyana umushinga kuva ku gishushanyo cya mbere kugeza ku gikoresho kiri ku meza, igakomeza kuwucunga.

breakthrough.title: Umufatanyabikorwa umwe kuri byose
breakthrough.blurb: Ikipe imwe ishushanya, yubaka, itanga kandi ifasha ikoranabuhanga ryawe, ku buryo nta kintu gitakara hagati y’abatanga serivisi.
body: Ibigo byinshi bicunga ikoranabuhanga ryabyo mu buryo bw’uduce: ikigo kimwe ku rubuga, umuhanga umwe kuri sisitemu, iduka rimwe kuri mudasobwa, undi ku muyoboro. Buri guhererekanya ni ahantu ibintu bipfira, kandi nta n’umwe ubazwa byose.

Kuri Linse, ikipe imwe ishushanya igicuruzwa, ikandika porogaramu, igatanga kandi igashyiraho ibikoresho, hanyuma igakomeza kubicunga. Amasezerano amwe, umuntu umwe uvugana nawe, ikipe imwe izi uko ibice bihuzwa.
Ibyo ni byo IT yose ahantu hamwe isobanura ku mukiriya: abatanga serivisi bake, ibyemezo byihuse, n’umufatanyabikorwa umwe ubazwa byose kuva ku gishushanyo cya mbere kugeza ku guhamagara ubufasha.

transformation.title: Serivisi esheshatu, ikipe imwe
transformation.blurb: Buri serivisi irihagije. Hamwe, zuzuza ibyo ikigo gikenera byose mu ikoranabuhanga.
body: Abashushanya porogaramu yawe ni bo bayubaka; ikipe ishyiraho umuyoboro wawe ni yo iwukurikirana; porogaramu dusohora zikora ku bikorwaremezo bimwe n’ibyo ducungira abakiriya.

stats.body: Sisitemu twahuje kugira ngo amadosiye, kwishyura na raporo bigende nta kongera kwandika.

stats.headline: 48 h
stats.body: Mudasobwa, seriveri, umuyoboro n’imashini zo kwishyuriraho z’ibirango cumi na bibiri, bishyirwaho kandi bifite garanti hano.

stats.headline: < 1 h
stats.body: Ubufasha, imiyoboro, cloud n’umutekano mu masezerano amwe, bikurikiranwa amanywa n’ijoro.

design.title: Igishushanyo
design.headline: Ibicuruzwa abantu bishimira gukoresha.
design.intro: Ikirango, ubushakashatsi bwa UX n’igishushanyo cya UI ku mbuga, telefoni n’ibikoresho by’imbere mu kigo. Dushushanya mu mucyo, hamwe n’ikipe yawe n’abakoresha, tugatanga sisitemu, si amashusho gusa.
design.more: Buri mushinga utangirira ku bantu bazakoresha igicuruzwa. Tugerageza hakiri kare n’abakoresha nyabo, twandika ibyemezo, tugasigira ikipe yawe sisitemu ishobora kwagura.

bullets.title: Ikirango n’amabwiriza yacyo
bullets.text: Ikirango, imyandikire, amabara n’ingero, byanditse ku buryo buri mutanga serivisi abikoresha kimwe.

bullets.title: Ubushakashatsi bwa UX, inzira n’ingero
bullets.text: Ibiganiro, inzira n’ingero zikanda, bigeragezwa n’abakoresha nyabo mbere yo kubaka.

bullets.title: Sisitemu z’igishushanyo cya UI (Figma)
bullets.text: Ibice, tokens n’ingero z’amapaji muri Figma, byiteguye kubakwa n’abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga.

bullets.title: Igishushanyo kigerwaho na bose (WCAG AA)
bullets.text: Itandukaniro ry’amabara, ingano y’inyuguti n’imikoreshereze y’abatabona bigenzurwa hakurikijwe WCAG AA.

stats.label: Kugera ku rugero rukanda
stats.note: Kuva ku nama ya mbere kugeza ku rugero abakoresha bawe bakanda bakarugerageza.

stats.label: Urwego rwo kugerwaho
stats.note: Buri paji igenzurwa: itandukaniro ry’amabara, ingano y’inyuguti, uko umuntu agenda kuri paji n’abatabona.

stats.label: Sisitemu y’igishushanyo kuri buri gicuruzwa
stats.note: Isomero rimwe ry’ibice risangiwe rituma buri paji nshya ihura n’izindi.

faqs.a: Yego. Igishushanyo ni serivisi yihariye; dutanga dosiye za Figma, sisitemu y’igishushanyo n’ibisobanuro ikipe yawe yubakiraho.
Yego, kuva ku kuvugurura gato kugeza ku kirango gishya cyose: ikirango, imyandikire, amabara n’ingero.

meta.title: Design ya UI/UX n'ibirango i Kigali
meta.description: Dushushanya porogaramu n'imbuga (UX/UI) n'ibirango by'ibicuruzwa by'ikoranabuhanga, bikora neza kuri telefoni na interineti yo mu Rwanda.

web.title: Imbuga & porogaramu
web.headline: Byihuta, bigerwaho na bose, biramba.
web.intro: Imbuga zamamaza, ubucuruzi bwo kuri internet, porogaramu za web n’iza telefoni ku ikoranabuhanga rigezweho: Next.js na React kuri web, Flutter kuri Android na iOS. Zibikwa, zikurikiranwa kandi zikitabwaho.
web.more: Twubakira ku ikoranabuhanga rizwi, dusohora mu byiciro bito, kandi dushyiraho ububiko, ikurikiranwa n’ibipimo kuva ku munsi wa mbere, kugira ngo urubuga rukomeze gukora neza nyuma yo gutangizwa.

bullets.title: Imbuga zamamaza n’iz’ibigo
bullets.text: Imbuga zihuta mu ndimi nyinshi, zigaragara mu bushakashatsi kandi ikipe yawe izivugurura byoroshye.

bullets.title: Ubucuruzi bwo kuri internet n’imbuga z’abakiriya
bullets.text: Urutonde rw’ibicuruzwa, kwishyura na mobile money n’amakarita, konti z’abakiriya no gukurikirana ibyatumijwe.

bullets.title: Porogaramu za telefoni (Flutter, Android & iOS)
bullets.text: Kode imwe ya Android na iOS, isohoka ku masoko yombi kandi ikitabwaho.

bullets.title: CMS, SEO n’ibipimo
bullets.text: Ibikubiye ku rubuga ikipe yawe ihindura nta muhanga, SEO ikozwe neza, n’imbonerahamwe zisobanutse.

stats.label: Intego y’imikorere ya Lighthouse
stats.note: Amapaji yihuta kuri telefoni na internet abakiriya bawe bakoresha koko.

stats.label: Indimi ziteguye
stats.note: Icyongereza, Igifaransa n’Ikinyarwanda kuva ku munsi wa mbere, bicungirwa muri CMS.

stats.label: Igihe ububiko bukora
stats.note: Bibitswe, bikurikiranwa kandi bifite kopi, hamwe n’imenyesha mbere y’uko abasura babona ikibazo.

faqs.a: Ni iyawe. Buri mushinga utangwa mu bubiko bwawe, hamwe n’inyandiko n’isomo ryo guhererekanya.

faqs.q: Twashobora guhindura ibikubiye ku rubuga ubwacu?
faqs.a: Yego. Dushyiraho CMS (Sanity mbere na mbere) kugira ngo ikipe yawe ihindure amapaji, amakuru n’ibicuruzwa nta muhanga.

meta.title: Gukora imbuga za interineti n'apps mu Rwanda
meta.description: Dukora imbuga za interineti, web apps n'apps za Android na iOS i Kigali: zihuta kuri telefoni, zemera MoMo, mu Cyongereza, Igifaransa n'Ikinyarwanda.

systems.title: Sisitemu & guhuza
systems.headline: Sisitemu zivugana.
systems.intro: ERP, HMIS, kwishyura, serivisi za Leta zikoresha ikoranabuhanga n’izindi sisitemu zihariye, zubakwa cyangwa zihuzwa. Twihariye mu gutuma sisitemu zisanzwe zisangira amakuru yizewe, hamwe n’amateka y’ibikorwa na raporo.
systems.more: Dusobanukirwa uko amakuru agenda mu kigo cyawe, duhuza sisitemu usanganywe, tukongeraho raporo abayobozi bawe bakeneye, tutajugunye ibikora neza.

bullets.title: Sisitemu zihariye n’ibikoresho by’imbere
bullets.text: Porogaramu zubakiye ku buryo ukora: kwemeza, inyandiko, gutegura gahunda n’imirimo yo hanze.

bullets.title: Gushyiraho no guhuza ERP / HMIS
bullets.text: Gutunganya, kwimura amakuru n’amahugurwa kuri ERP na sisitemu z’amakuru y’ibitaro.

bullets.title: Guhuza kwishyura, mobile money na banki
bullets.text: Kwakira, kwishyura no guhuza konti binyuze kuri API za mobile money, amakarita na banki.

bullets.title: Kwimura amakuru, raporo n’imbonerahamwe
bullets.text: Kwimura amakuru bisukuye kandi bigenzuwe, n’imbonerahamwe zihindura amakuru ibyemezo.

stats.label: Guhuza kwatanzwe
stats.note: Mobile money, amabanki, serivisi za Leta, ERP na sisitemu z’ibitaro.

stats.label: Amakuru yatakaye mu kwimura
stats.note: Buri kwimura amakuru kugeragezwa, kugenzurwa no kwemezwa mbere yo gutangira gukoreshwa.

stats.label: Ikurikiranwa
stats.note: Guhuza gukurikiranwa amanywa n’ijoro, hakaba imenyesha iyo guhuza kunaniranye.

faqs.a: Yego, harimo IremboGov, RRA na API za mobile money, hubahirizwa ibisabwa byazo.
Yego. Dutangira n’isuzuma, tugashyira ku murongo ibiri gukora, hanyuma tugategura kunoza.

meta.title: Sisitemu, POS no kwishyura na MoMo
meta.description: Sisitemu z'ubucuruzi zikorana: POS, ERP n'ububiko, kwishyura na MTN MoMo na Airtel Money, no guhuza porogaramu musanganywe.

software.title: Porogaramu zacu
software.headline: Ibicuruzwa twubaka, dutunga kandi ducunga.
software.intro: Linse ishora mu bicuruzwa byayo bwite ikabitangira uruhushya ku isoko. MacyePay, urubuga rwacu rwo kwishyura mu byiciro, ni rwo rwa mbere; ibindi biri mu iterambere.
software.more: Gutunga ibicuruzwa byacu bisobanura ko twirengera igiciro cyo kubikora neza. Abakiriya babona porogaramu yamaze kugeragezwa ku isoko, ifite ubufasha n’igenamigambi bafasha gushyiraho.

bullets.title: MacyePay — kwishyura mu byiciro hamwe no kwishyuza byemewe n’amategeko
bullets.text: Amasezerano yo kwishyura mu byiciro yemejwe na noteri, kwibutsa no kwishyuza byikora, n’amanota y’icyizere kuri buri mukiriya.

bullets.title: Uruhushya cyangwa serivisi icungwa
bullets.text: Yikoreshe nka serivisi icungwa wishyura buri kwezi, cyangwa uyihabwe uruhushya ku bikorwaremezo byawe.

bullets.title: Igenamigambi riyobowe n’abakiriya
bullets.text: Ibishya biva mu bigo bikoresha igicuruzwa buri munsi, bigasuzumwa buri gihembwe.

bullets.title: Ubufasha na SLA birimo
bullets.text: Gutangiza, amahugurwa n’igihe cyo gusubiza cyemeranyijweho biri muri buri gahunda.

stats.label: Igicuruzwa gikora
stats.note: MacyePay, ikora kandi icungwa n’ikipe yacu.

stats.label: Amasezerano akora kuri MacyePay
stats.note: Amasezerano yo kwishyura mu byiciro acungwa kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo kuri urwo rubuga.

stats.label: Igipimo cyo kwishyuza
stats.note: Ku masezerano akora, bitewe n’amasezerano yemejwe na noteri no kwibutsa byikora.

faqs.a: Nka serivisi icungwa yishyurwa buri kwezi kuri buri kigo, cyangwa nk’uruhushya ku mabanki n’abacuruzi banini. Saba kuyerekwa.
Yego. Twubakana kandi dufatanya gutunga ibicuruzwa n’abafatanyabikorwa bazana isoko; tuvugishe.

meta.title: MacyePay: kwishyura mu byiciro
meta.description: MacyePay ifasha amaduka n'amabanki kugurisha telefoni, mudasobwa n'ibindi byishyurwa mu byiciro, n'amasezerano yemejwe na noteri na MoMo.

hardware.title: Ibikoresho & ikwirakwizwa
hardware.headline: Ibikoresho by’umwuga, bigezwa kandi bigafashwa.
hardware.intro: Mudasobwa zigendanwa n’izo ku meza, seriveri, umuyoboro, imashini zisohora inyandiko, kamera z’umutekano n’imashini zo kwishyuriraho z’ibirango byizewe. Biraboneka, bigezwa kandi bigashyirwaho mu Rwanda hose, garanti icungirwa hano.
hardware.more: Duha igiciro cy’ibikoresho byose bikenewe, si amakarito gusa: ibikoresho bikwiye umurimo, bitunganywa mbere yo kugezwa, bigashyirwaho aho bikoreshwa kandi bigafashwa na serivisi ya garanti iri hafi.

bullets.title: Mudasobwa zigendanwa, izo ku meza n’iz’akazi kenshi
bullets.text: Moderi z’umwuga z’ibirango byizewe, zitunganywa mbere yo kugera ku meza yanyu.

bullets.title: Seriveri, ububiko n’umuyoboro
bullets.text: Seriveri, ububiko, switch, router na Wi-Fi, bihuje n’aho mukorera.

bullets.title: Imashini zisohora inyandiko, scanner, kamera & POS
bullets.text: Gusohora inyandiko mu biro, kamera z’umutekano n’imashini zo kwishyuriraho mu maduka n’amashami.

bullets.title: Garanti, gusana n’ubufasha aho muri
bullets.text: Garanti icungirwa hano, gusana bikurikiranwa, n’abatekinisiye baza aho muri igihe bikenewe.

stats.label: Ibirango dukwirakwiza
stats.note: Ibikoresho by’umwuga by’abakora bizewe, garanti icungirwa hano.

stats.label: Kugezwa i Kigali
stats.note: Bitunganywa mbere yo kuva mu iduka ryacu, bigashyirwaho bikihagera.

stats.label: Garanti isanzwe
stats.note: Garanti no gusana bicungirwa hano kandi bigakurikiranwa kugeza igikoresho kigarutse.

faqs.q: Mugurisha ku bantu ku giti cyabo?
faqs.a: Twibanda ku bigo, amashuri n’inzego, ariko dukorera n’abantu ku giti cyabo ku bicuruzwa bimwe.
Yego: ibikoresho, umuyoboro, umutekano no kubishyiraho mu giciro kimwe. Saba urutonde.

meta.title: Mudasobwa, POS n'ibikoresho bya IT mu Rwanda
meta.description: Mudasobwa z'akazi, seriveri, ibikoresho bya network, imashini za POS, printer na CCTV ku bigo, tubigeza aho muri hose mu Rwanda.

it.title: Serivisi za IT
it.headline: Gucunga, gukurikirana, kurinda.
it.intro: IT icungwa ku makipe y’ingano iyo ari yo yose: ubufasha, imiyoboro, cloud, kubika kopi n’umutekano. Amasezerano amwe, umuntu umwe uvugana nawe, igihe cyo gusubiza cyemeranyijweho.
it.more: Dukurikirana sisitemu zanyu amanywa n’ijoro, dukemura ibibazo mbere y’uko bikwira, kandi buri kwezi tubamenyesha ibyakozwe n’ibikurikiraho.

bullets.title: Ubufasha n’ubufasha aho muri
bullets.text: Nimero imwe n’aderesi imwe kuri buri kibazo, abatekinisiye bakaza aho muri i Kigali hose.

bullets.title: Imiyoboro, Wi-Fi n’insinga ziteguwe
bullets.text: Gutegura, gushyira insinga na Wi-Fi mu biro, amashuri, amavuriro n’ububiko.

bullets.title: Cloud, Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, kubika kopi
bullets.text: Imeli, dosiye n’indangamuntu za konti muri cloud, kopi zisubizwaho kandi zigeragezwa buri gihe.

bullets.title: Umutekano: mudasobwa, kamera, kugenzura kwinjira
bullets.text: Ibikoresho birinzwe, kamera zikurikiranwa no kugenzura kwinjira, byose bicungirwa ahantu hamwe.

stats.label: Igihe cyo gusubiza ibibazo bikomeye
stats.note: Umutekinisiye atangira gukemura ibibazo bikomeye mu isaha imwe.

stats.label: Igihe sisitemu zikora
stats.note: Imiyoboro, seriveri na serivisi za cloud ducunga, bipimwa buri kwezi.

stats.label: Amasezerano kuri byose
stats.note: Ubufasha, imiyoboro, cloud n’umutekano mu masezerano amwe.

faqs.a: Yego. Amasezerano ya buri kwezi afite amasaha azwi n’igihe cyo gusubiza cyemeranyijweho, bijyanye n’ingano y’ikipe yanyu.
Yego, nyuma yo gusuzuma vuba ibyo mufite.

meta.title: Ubufasha bwa IT ku bigo i Kigali
meta.description: Twita kuri IT y'ikigo cyanyu: amasezerano y'ubufasha afite SLA, network, kubika amakuru (backup) n'abatekinisiye baza aho mukorera.

models.title: Uburyo bwo gukorana
models.blurb: Hitamo uburyo bukwiye umurimo. Abakiriya benshi batangirira ku mushinga bagakomeza ku masezerano ya buri kwezi.

items.title: Umushinga
items.text: Ibikorwa, igiciro n’igihe bizwi. Bikwiye urubuga rushya, porogaramu cyangwa sisitemu.

items.title: Amasezerano & ubufasha
items.text: Amasaha ya buri kwezi n’igihe cyo gusubiza cyemeranyijweho, byo gucunga no kunoza ibyo mufite.

items.title: Uruhushya rw’igicuruzwa
items.text: Koresha porogaramu dusohora, nka serivisi icungwa cyangwa uruhushya rw’ikigo.

items.title: Kubakana
items.text: Twubakana igicuruzwa n’umufatanyabikorwa uzana isoko, tugasangira ubutunzi bw’ibivuyemo.

supercycle.title: Ikoranabuhanga rikomeza gukora
supercycle.blurb: Agaciro kenshi k’ikoranabuhanga kaza nyuma yo kuritangiza.
body: Urubuga, sisitemu cyangwa umuyoboro w’ibiro bigira akamaro gusa iyo bikora. Ikipe yacu ya serivisi za IT icunga ibyo twubaka n’ibyo usanganywe: ubufasha, imiyoboro, cloud, kubika kopi n’umutekano, mu masezerano amwe afite igihe cyo gusubiza cyemeranyijweho.

Dukurikirana amanywa n’ijoro, dukemura ibibazo mbere y’uko bikwira kandi buri kwezi tubamenyesha ibyakozwe. Iyo ikibazo gikomeye gikeneye umuntu aho muri i Kigali, umutekinisiye atangira kugikemura mu isaha imwe.

quote.text: Umunsi wo gutangiza ni wo woroshye. Icyo abakiriya bacu bagura koko ni buri munsi usanzwe ukurikiraho: sisitemu zikurikiranwa, zivugururwa kandi zigakosorwa mbere y’uko hagira ubibona, n’abantu bazi neza uko zubatse.
quote.name: Ubuyobozi bwa Linse

runway.title: MacyePay: intangiriro ikomeye, urugendo rurerure
runway.tagline: Igicuruzwa cyacu cya mbere twasohoye: kwishyura mu byiciro bishingiye ku masezerano yemejwe na noteri, gicungwa n’ikipe yacu.

process.title: Uko dukora
process.blurb: Intambwe enye zimwe kuri buri mushinga, uko ungana kose.
process.body: Ubona porogaramu ikora buri byumweru bibiri, ibyemezo byandikwa, kandi umuntu umwe ni we ubazwa umushinga wose, kuva ku nama ya mbere kugeza ku munsi wo gutangiza n’inyuma yawo.

steps.title: Gusesengura
steps.text: Dusobanukirwa ikibazo, abakoresha n’imbogamizi mbere yo kwandika umurongo umwe.

steps.title: Gushushanya
steps.text: Inzira, imigaragarire n’imiterere, bisuzumwa hamwe nawe.

steps.title: Kubaka
steps.text: Ibyiciro bigufi, porogaramu ikora buri byumweru bibiri, igeragezwa aho ikoreshwa.

steps.title: Gukoresha
steps.text: Turashyira mu bikorwa, dukurikirana kandi dufasha, tugakomeza kunoza.

sub.includedBlurb: Ibintu bine wizera iyo dukorana kuri: {service}.
sub.includedBody: Buri mushinga usobanurwa mu nyandiko, ugatangwa n’ikipe izawufasha, kandi ugapimwa hakurikijwe imibare iri hepfo.
sub.relatedBlurb: Imishinga iyi serivisi yakoreyemo akazi kanini.

macyepay.blurb: Kwishyura mu byiciro ku bigo byo mu Rwanda, bishingiye ku masezerano yemejwe na noteri, kwishyuza byikora no guhuzwa na CRB.

retail-rollout.blurb: Imashini zo kwishyuriraho, umuyoboro n’ubufasha aho bari ku mucuruzi ufite amashami menshi.
